references.text: The people traveled from Kibroth-hattaavah to Hazeroth, which is the place they departed from in 12:16.
The Wilderness of Paran is mentioned as a place where the Israelites camped after leaving the Wilderness of Sinai.
Moses sent spies from the Wilderness of Paran, confirming that the people were camped there.
The spies returned to Kadesh in the Wilderness of Paran, where the people were camped.
Paran is mentioned as one of the places in the wilderness where Moses spoke to Israel.
The Wilderness of Paran is mentioned as the place where Ishmael lived, highlighting the geographical significance of the wilderness.
Hazeroth and Rithmah (in the region of Paran) are mentioned in the travel record of Israel's journey.
